system.description:
• Effect: After a successful track check, determine accurately the number in the tracked party, their make-up (war band, hunting party, etc.), whether well or lightly armed, their speed, and their habits.
  • A second successful Wisdom check (+1 only) can predict their intended direction of travel; a third can identify their specific destination

activities.name: Advanced Tracking
activities.text: After a successful track, a further check predicts the party's direction, and a third its destination.
